# Feature: SLC-3 Send-Context + Agent-Tools

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-23 — refine from issue #3 + design -->

## Intent

Roadmap: SLC-3 (Stufe B) — Bei explizitem Send mit Chips stellt das Plugin eine kompakte VisualBatch-Repräsentation genau für den nächsten Agent-Turn bereit (ohne Transcript-Metadaten), und registriert read-only Agent-Tools mit fail-closed Session-Auth (FR-021..FR-023, FR-033).

## Preconditions

- SLC-1/2 on branch base: VisualBatchStore, prepareSend/admitSend/rejectSend, bridge, composer chips
- OpenClaw host ≥2026.9.4; plugin built; Custom Plugin UI enabled for composer replacement
- Exact `(sessionKey, agentId)` available on session-action and tool invocation contexts

## Happy Path

- [ ] Given draft chips in session A, when `prepare_send` then host `send` admitted then `send_outcome(admitted=true)`, then compact next-turn context is enqueued exactly for A and chips clear (SCN-021, FR-021); Cardinality: one preparation / one injection per admitted send event
- [ ] Given admitted sent archive, when agent calls `agent_visual_editor.get_active_context` / `get_selection` with A's identity, then bounded redacted details return (C-012/C-013, SCN-018)
- [ ] Given Session B tool context, when requesting A's batch/selection, then `forbidden` / denied (T-025, SCN-022, INV-3)
- [ ] Given preparing send, when `send_outcome(admitted=false)`, then draft+chips retained and no context is available to a later unrelated message (T-015, SCN-014, RISK-004)
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict)

## Edge Cases

- [ ] `stale_batch` / `stale_preparation` return German recovery messages (FR-033, C-010/C-011)
- [ ] Session delete/reset retires admitted archive; tools return `no_context` / `not_found` (EDGE-005, T-011)
- [ ] `get_screenshot` without artifact → `not_found` / `expired` stub (C-014 until SLC-5)
- [ ] Oversized tool fields truncated with metadata where applicable (NFR-006)
- [ ] Send without session identity → `no_session_context`, no silent fallback (INV-3)

## Regression

- [ ] Chip attach/remove/clear still never send (INV-1)
- [ ] SLC-1/2 tests (T-001, T-002, T-004, T-005) remain green
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test` and plugin validate green

## Assumptions

- With `mountDefault`, host-owned Send uses `agent_turn_prepare` fallback for same-turn `prependContext` when chips exist; explicit `prepare_send`/`send_outcome` remain the contract for tests and any UI wrap of `props.send`
- Screenshot bytes are out of scope; tool is a fail-closed stub
- Domscribe SourceContext stays degraded/empty (SLC-4)
